configurations.name: Additional/total coverage message
configurations.source: Global shared message selection only. Effective Sites select the additional-coverage or total-coverage message; the default is applyForAdditional. This setting does not affect calculations, eligibility, amount choices, validation or in-force deductions. User decision November 16, 2026; src/components/coverage/ProductCatalog.tsx

configurations.name: Show itemized product cost breakdown
configurations.source: Shared Coverage presentation; itemize only reconciled quote components. Pricing policies own fees, credits and rider values; the display setting never adds charges. User decision November 15, 2026.
